overview: After eight years of studying at the St. Petersburg Medical University, Mitya returns to his native village of Ozernoye, somewhere in the vast south of Russia. His family, friends, and the whole village are waiting for him with pride and impatience, because special funds were spent on his studies, and a young doctor at the local hospital is also very much needed. But everyone is surprised to find out that Mitya is not a surgeon, dentist, or even a urologist, but a sex psychologist. Conservative residents do not accept Mitya, they call him a "pussy doctor", his own father threatens to recant, but Mitya does not give up. Because he knows how much help is needed for people who are not enlightened in sexual matters, who for generations have tabooed the topic of "this very thing" and live in a world of myths, superstitions and prejudices.
title: Про это самое

overview: Moscow journalist comes to the Pervomaysky farmstead to interview Efrosinya Semenova, a heroic mother who lost nine sons in the war, on assignment from the editorial office. During long conversations, he discovers the courage and heroism of each son, as well as the indestructible strength of spirit of Efrosinya.
title: Солдатская мать
Meng Bao Zhu Gong: Wu Shi Sui Hun Chong
My Life Is Not My Husband's

overview: TCL's 2025 season—its third—will launch with the Boston vs. New York battle (from Foxwoods Casino), featuring teams composed of rising male and female talent alongside seasoned veterans. Competitors in the first and only professional boxing league with a team-based ownership model will face off across 12 different weight classes in 24 action-packed, three-minute rounds, with team performance determining the overall winner.
title: TCL Team Boxing League

overview: The series looks at what happens when scientists, inventors and engineers turn to the dark side – from the Italian Mafia's assassination drones and Columbian cartels' secret narco subs, to a network of New York City heroin processing labs and the ingenious escape routes in Pablo Escobar's Hacienda and Catêdral hideouts
title: Building Bad

overview: The talk show "In the Circle of Light" is a joint project of the famous TV presenter Svetlana Sorokina and the editor-in-chief of the radio station "Echo of Moscow" Alexey Venediktov. This is a program for those who care about the fate of their loved ones, who are concerned about the future of their children, who are ready to fight for the happiness of their families. The program raises issues of social development in Russia, examines current problems of family, motherhood and childhood, and discusses the most important aspects of human relationships.
title: В круге света

overview: The scheming concubine-born daughter of the Minister's household, Bai Xiyue, caused the death of her legitimate sister Bai Xiyao, and seduced Duke Yun Yichen, eventually becoming empress. However, she was poisoned and died suddenly during the coronation ceremony. After being reborn with all her memories, this time as her sister Bai Xiyao, she finds herself face to face with the younger, ruthless version of her former self. Now, she must endure the very schemes she once used on others, strive to protect herself while atoning for her past sins, and navigate the tangled web of love and destiny.
title: Phoenix's Gambit: Love or Crown

overview: When Ditte Jensen retires with distinction from the Danish Secret Service, she movesinto an apartment block in Reykjavik where she will be able to tend her garden andlive out her life in anonymity. But Ditte can not stop being how she is. An elite soldier and a warrior. And soon the apartment building become here a battlefield for a better world. With her deep rooted sense of justice she sees her neighbor's problems and is compelled to help, whether they want her help or not. And in her world, the end justifies the means. Always.
title: Danska Konan

overview: A multidisciplinary clinic treating a wide range of traumas and human dramas. A variety of medical specialists work here, from anaesthetists and gynaecologists to plastic surgeons. Nurses are also available, where without them. Every day, these people not only save lives, treat illnesses and help people, they also have their own lives - their own problems, which, more often than not, lead to extremely difficult life situations. You may doubt it, but these doctors care about their own problems, and they care a lot!
title: Верное средство

overview: Host Becca Scott gathers her comedian friends for a game night like no other.
title: Parlor Room

overview: From homicide to patrol, cameras follow the detectives and officers of the Grand Rapids Police Department.
title: All Access PD: Grand Rapids

overview: When Lauren returns home to her flat in London late one night, she is greeted at the door by her husband, Michael. There's only one problem — she's never seen this man before in her life. As Lauren tries to puzzle out how she could be married to someone she can't remember meeting, Michael goes to the attic to change a lightbulb and abruptly disappears. In his place, a new husband emerges. Realizing that her attic is creating an infinite supply of husbands, Lauren confronts the question: If swapping lives is as easy as changing a lightbulb, how do you know you've taken the right path? When do you stop trying to do better and start actually living?
title: The Husbands
Qin Ai De Chu Shen Da Ren

overview: "Set in 1920s Shanghai, a city teeming with mystery, cultural fusion, and intrigue, Tianyuan Zhan and Liu Weiyi co-found a private detective agency. Both secretly in love with their childhood friend, Rong Shaojuan, their bond is shattered when Shaojuan tragically dies in a car accident while helping Tianyuan on a case. Blaming each other, the two part ways, and Weiyi joins the police force. Meanwhile, Xiang Jingrong, mysteriously tied to the accident, vanishes without a trace. Her daughter, Zhang Ziqing, returns from abroad to search for her missing mother. By twist of fate, she joins Tianyuan's detective agency, and together they begin investigating a series of seemingly unrelated and baffling cases, only to uncover a shadowy criminal organization led by the elusive and dangerous Mr. Bai. As Weiyi pursues the truth from within the police force, his path gradually converges with Tianyuan's. Despite past conflicts, they find themselves fighting a common enemy. In the end, with courage and cleverness, Tianyuan and his allies dismantle the criminal empire and expose Mr. Bai's sinister plot, ultimately paving the way for justice, closure, and new beginnings in both life and love."
title: Hunter Jame

overview: Dirty Jobs videos follow the unsung laborers who make a living in some of the most unthinkable ways.
title: Dirty Jobs

overview: At a class reunion, Qin Suyan is drawn into a deadly game where players face ruthless rules, real danger, and growing distrust—especially with the mastermind hiding among them. As others give in to fear and violence, Qin Suyan holds on to her compassion. While uncovering a connection to a long-buried case, she must decide whether revealing the truth is worth the cost.
title: Atonement

overview: Kostas Charitos is head of the Homicide Section of the Athens Police. Tenacious, he does not lose heart even when faced with the most difficult cases. Kostas is married to Adriana and has a daughter, Caterina, for whom he feels total love. In The commissioner's family background looms over the despotic figure of his policeman father at the time of the Colonels' dictatorship and passive spectator, if not accomplice, of the interrogations and violence inflicted on the regime's opponents.
title: Kostas

overview: ATP: The Carriers is a story of true brotherhood on the road, where every kilometer tests endurance, trust, and courage. Artem and Semen are delivery drivers who navigate tough routes, handle emergencies, and fight to keep their struggling transport company alive. Their job isn't just about moving cargo. It's about challenges that shape character, unexpected threats, twists of fate, and facing their own fears. This series blends adventure, drama, and humor — where the road is tough, but the bond of friendship is tougher.
title: АТП Перевізники

overview: Get in the Dome. Get the diamond. Get away. In this documentary executive produced by Guy Ritchie, a group of gangsters plan the heist of a lifetime.

overview: Ana Páez was a 35-year-old fashion designer who was found dead in a tourist apartment in Barcelona on February 19, 2008, naked and with a plastic bag covering her head. How did she die? Was it a sexual crime or a sadistic game gone wrong? This was the initial hypothesis with which the police were working until Angi appeared. This documentary miniseries revisits what the media dubbed 'The Almost Perfect Crime' and sheds light on the figure of María Ángeles Molina ('Angi') and her past with her husband, Juan Antonio Álvarez Litben, who died unexpectedly in 1996.
title: Angi: Crimen y mentira

overview: A diverse panel of journalists navigates the week's biggest stories and sets the agenda for the week ahead, offering context, analysis, and civil debate in a three-hour Saturday and Sunday evening format.
title: The Weekend Primetime

overview: Young girl Su Hua eloped with General Xiao Yun for love, but was betrayed by her elder sister and violated and buried alive by the second young master, Xiao Ye. Su Hua is "reborn" as the courtesan Qing Yan, enters into a marriage deal with Xiao Yun, and steps into the Xiao Residence to begin her revenge. Along the way, she fights through countless obstacles, rescues other persecuted women, ultimately brings punishment upon the Xiao family, and finally regains her true identity to reunite with Xiao Yun.
title: Destiny of the General's Bride

overview: Timecaster Luo Jie is accidentally transported into the body of a tycoon's illegitimate son, Lang, with the power to turn into a time pocket watch. In his quest to uncover the truth behind Lang's mysterious death, he becomes entangled in the Qian Gang's power struggles, crosses paths with Inspector Ye Sijia and the quirky Qi, and finds himself hunted by multiple factions. Luo Jie eventually uncovers that the mastermind behind it all is deeply linked to One Word of Humility and an impending catastrophe yet to come...
title: Destiny Switch

overview: The Joe Schmo Show is a one-hour, 10-episode series featuring a real guy who believes he is on an over-the-top reality show looking for America's next bounty hunter and the chance to win $100k. What he doesn't know is the entire show is FAKE. For over a year his entire world was carefully planned by a team of writers, producers, and actors all performing for him. His "competitors" are actually actors representing every classic reality show cliché, including the Buddy, the Jerk, the Model, and even Lorenzo Lamas, playing a washed-up version of himself. The actors must do their best under these insane circumstances to follow a pre-determined script. One break in character or a single misspoken word could bring the entire show crashing down around them. He'll experience everything from flame throwers and stun guns to being chained to federal inmates and capturing his own fugitive. "Joe" must navigate this ridiculous world while we discover how a contestant reacts to being thrust on a show filled with every outlandish element reality television has to offer. How far can producers push this 'reality,' and the ensuing ridiculous competitions? Will "Joe's" character remain intact? And of course, will the actors be convincing enough or will our unsuspecting "Joe" figure it all out?
title: The Joe Schmo Show

overview: High school sweethearts and married couple, Daphne Reckert and Ian Figueira, will abandon their plans of living in a California tiny home when Daphne inherits her late grandfather's 500-year-old chateau on a 130-acre estate just outside of Paris, France. While the main floor of the sprawling property—which once welcomed guests like King Louis XIII— provides a steady income stream hosting weddings, the young couple will take on the incredibly daunting task of restoring the remaining dilapidated floors and buildings on the grounds, utilizing their carpentry, conservation and landscaping expertise, as well as their families' backgrounds in construction, design and renovation. With passion, determination and grit, Daphne and Ian will confront budget constraints, battle bug infestations, hunt for rumored hidden treasure and tackle a seemingly endless list of projects head-on to breathe new life into the historic estate and preserve her grandfather's legacy.
title: Castle Impossible
Dan Mu Jiao Wo Lai Gong Dou

However, the rescuers are ordinary people who also experience personal drama.

overview: Qué Tranza promises an unfiltered, laugh-out-loud experience that blends real-life dilemmas, wild anecdotes, and brutally honest advice. Each week, the hosts dive into personal stories submitted by listeners — tackling topics ranging from relationship drama and workplace chaos to existential questions — always with heart, humor, and just the right touch of irreverence. Whether listeners are dealing with heartbreak, family issues, or just need to disconnect from the daily grind, Qué Tranza offers a hilarious and heartfelt escape.

After running afoul of the law one time too many, she is given the choice between jail and going to live with relatives on a ranch in Montana. Upon arriving in Montana, the street-hardened young girl experiences the ultimate culture shock.

The goal is to get into the school's popular, tough gang of boys, who even hang out in the school attic - as long as Rasmus doesn't screw up the whole thing.
title: ÄIJÄ

overview: Maria de Déa, Lampião's companion and first woman in the Cangaço, is a fearless young woman who dares to have a voice in a group of outlaws. In a life of escapes and armed disputes, Maria faces a pregnancy and is subdued to the harshest law of the Cangaço: handing over her baby to be raised by someone else. She begins to live between life in the group and the hopeless desire to raise her daughter.

title: Clarence

overview: Shen Qingtang, whose family was destroyed when she was young, was taken in by Pei Congzhi, the eldest son of the Chengping Marquis' family, and became a foster daughter in the Pei household, living as his nominal sister. Over the years, she endured unfair treatment and oppression within the Pei family. The only person who could be called her protective brother, Pei Congzhi, is also a dangerous figure, leaving her uncertain of how to navigate him. With the constant pressure from the Pei household wearing her down, Shen Qingtang decides to break free, leaving Pei Congzhi behind, and escaping from a life full of peril and uncertainty...

overview: Series looking at the volatile weather above four different continents, and how the creatures below find ingenious ways of surviving wind, rain, drought and blizzards.

overview: Phoebe helps her fellow students at Attaway Middle School with problems of stress and romance while working up the courage to ask out her own crush.

overview: Sia, a university student chasing his dream of becoming a musician, lives a quiet life filled with uncertainty. Everything changes when he meets Blue, a former senior from his music club who died years ago. Blue's unexpected return from beyond the grave brings more than just fear. It awakens a connection Sia never saw coming. When a mysterious pact binds their souls, the line between the living and the dead begins to blur. Sia is pulled into a journey that will change everything, with no way back.

overview: My View with Lara Trump features big picture analysis and interviews with thought leaders, shedding light on the headlines driving the national conversation and affecting families around the country.

overview: Kinahan: The True Story of Ireland's Mafia tracks the Kinahan Cartel from its beginnings as a small-time street dealing operation in 1980s Dublin, to one the world's most feared and notorious criminal organisations. It is a story of gangland feuding, double dealing, betrayal, international law enforcement, and murder. Providing new insight, information and exclusive interviews, this four-part series tells the in-depth story of the cartel known as the Kinahan Transnational Criminal Organisation (KTCO), with roots that start in Ireland but spread to the UK, mainland Europe and around the world.
title: Kinahan: The True Story of Ireland's Mafia

overview: A revenge drama about a woman who believed she had a perfect life and then had her life completely stolen from her.

overview: The return of the iconic show at the Crumlin Road Gaol, Belfast brings epic strength tests which push the 16 strongmen to their limits as they aim to become Ireland's Strongest Man

overview: Focusing on questions of identity and conflict in the (mostly) post-socialist world, Tracks East approaches difficult issues from new vantage points to shed light on our complex present.
title: Tracks East

overview: Meet Siiri and Irma, best friends and the queen bees of Sunset Grove, a retirement community for those still young at heart. With a combined age of nearly 180, Siiri and Irma are still just as inquisitive and witty as when they first met decades ago. But when their comfortable world is upturned by a suspicious death at Sunset Grove, Siiri and Irma are shocked into doing something about it. Determined to find out exactly what happened and why, they begin their own private investigations and form The Lavender Ladies Detective Agency. The trouble is, beneath Sunset Grove's calm facade, there is more going on than meets the eye, and Siiri and Irma soon discover far more than they bargained for.

overview: Peter Miller travels the world looking for the hottest fishing spots.

overview: Following groups of Brits as they cruise the Mediterranean's most glamorous spots.

overview: A two-part documentary about the abduction of single mother Tina Herrmann, her two children and a neighbour in the sleepy Ohio town of Apple Valley in 2010.

overview: A marriage alliance between two powerful families takes an unexpected turn when a mysterious figure shows up at the engagement party and shares a surprisingly intimate moment with the bride-to-be. Caught between family duty, tangled emotions, and a web of deceit, the bride is thrown into chaos. As the stranger's true motives slowly come to light, a gripping tale of revenge, love, and betrayal begins to unfold at the heart of a wealthy family's dark secrets.

overview: In the 1920s, Rafael and Luna fall in love. Murdered on the orders of the envious Cristina, Luna reincarnates as Serena and falls in love with Rafael again, confirming their eternal love.

overview: Rather than focusing solely on the identity of the killer, Jack the Ripper: Written in Blood delves into how the Whitechapel Murders fuelled the rise of tabloid journalism in Britain. The series shines a light on one newspaper in particular – The Star – and its shameless exploitation of the killings to boost circulation and profits, hindering the police investigation to further its own agenda. Through the eyes of present-day experts, this gripping series immerses viewers in the turbulent Victorian era, offering a unique perspective on how the press manipulated the story for its own gain, ultimately obstructing justice in the process. Through the eyes of present-day experts – including investigative journalists, former detectives, psychologists, historians, a former prostituted woman and author, and forensic experts – this gripping series immerses viewers in the turbulent Victorian era, offering a unique perspective on how the press manipulated the story for its own gain, ultimately obstructing justice in the process.
title: Jack the Ripper: Written in Blood

overview: Their lives could not be more different. While his workday is ending, hers is just beginning. In this story, Angélica is a beautiful prostitute, known as ‘Poderosa', who regularly visits a roadside gas station. It is there that she meets the agronomist Miguel, a nobleman from São Paulo with a good character, who sells the vegetables he grows on his property. They barely cross paths, the attraction is evident, although they have no idea what the future holds for them. Rejected by her father as a child, Angélica is a woman who soon became independent and is, without knowing it, involved in many mysteries. One of them has to do with a conspiracy to assassinate her. A task that is not easy at all, and which will be made more difficult by the unconditional passion that grows between the Angélica and Miguel.
title: Amor Sem Igual

overview: Follow the lives and loves of six thirty-somethings in a heart-warming and comic drama as they try to find true love - or at least keep their relationships on track.
title: Cold Feet

overview: In Ultimate Processes, presenter Francesca Chiorando visits ten very different places to discover what goes on in the world of modern manufacturing.
title: Ultimate Processes

overview: Writer and historian Sergei Minaev travels through space and time to the sites of great histories—the Freemasons, the Knights Templar, Suleiman the Magnificent, the Borgias, the Medici dynasty, and the Holy Inquisition. Following these heroes, viewers will travel to Istanbul, Paris, Florence, Venice, Segovia, Toledo, Avignon, Valencia, Rome, and other cities around the world.

overview: Sue Johanson was Canada's foremost sexual educator and counsellor, recipient of the distinguished Order of Canada. From 2002 until 2008, Sue's wisdom and experience were available to American viewers on "Talk Sex with Sue Johanson", a live phone-in program that aired on Oxygen TV. "Talk Sex" also aired in 23 other countries, including Europe and Brazil. Weekly production ended in May 2008.
title: Talk Sex with Sue Johanson

overview: Kathputli is a tale of how greed and deceit can lead to one's downfall, while honesty and patience pave the way to success. At the heart of this narrative are Tabeen and Areeba, two sisters whose vastly different natures set them on contrasting paths. Tabeen embodies sincerity, intelligence, and patience, while Areeba thrives on manipulation, ambition, and greed. Caught between them is Ayan, whose affection becomes a pivotal element in their lives. Unaware of the hidden truths and concealed feelings around him, Ayan's heart becomes a battleground for honesty and deceit. Will Tabeen find the strength to speak her heart, or will silence be her fate? Ultimately, will Areeba's cunning ambitions secure her desires, or will honesty and virtue triumph in the end?
title: Kathputli

overview: The Sunday Night Sex Show was a live call-in Canadian television show hosted by Sue Johanson, which ran from 1996 to 2005. It aired on the W Network and was one of their most popular programs. Every week, callers would line up on the phone to talk to Johanson, about various topics from how to spice up one's sex life, to advice on how to select the right sex toy, to how to deal with various relationship issues. For many years, reruns of the television show ran on the Oxygen Network in the United States, but American viewers were frustrated that they couldn't call in during the live airing in Canada. Eventually, a US version of the show, titled Talk Sex with Sue Johanson, was created.
title: Sunday Night Sex Show

overview: Get ready for an unforgettable showdown in Las Vegas this September – December! BattleBots Destruct-A-Thon is bringing you a series of World Championship VIII pre-qualifier events featuring the biggest names in robotic combat. Each weekend, four elite teams will face off in intense round-robin battles, showcasing their unrivaled fighting prowess. Witness the most feared robots in the sport go head-to-head with rising stars. All the action will be available on our YouTube channel, with early access exclusively for our Facebook Supporters.
title: BattleBots FaceOffs

overview: Tsunami - Return to Paradise is a 4-part documentary whose main characters have fought for his life in the tsunami and lost all their family members Liisa Suonsivu and Gerts Friman, a diver Jani Mäkinen, who survived the tsunami and worked in a rescue operation, and Detective Inspector Ismo Kopra, who worked in Thailand after a year after the disaster, responsible for identifying and sending every Finn deceased home. In the documentary, the main characters return to Thailand and places they can never forget.
title: Tsunami - Paluu paratiisiin

overview: In this documentary Tristan Hughes investigates Orkney's enigmatic Neolithic past. Crawling into 5,000 year old tombs and digging deep into one of the greatest archaeological excavations currently underway on the British Isles, he explores this extraordinary period of Scotland's prehistory.
title: Mysteries of Prehistoric Scotland
